description_en: Call `DeleteRtcAsrTask` to delete a real-time speech-to-text or translation task
description_zh: 调用DeleteRtcAsrTask删除实时语音转文字或翻译任务
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-rtc-asr-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id asr-51c72000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRtcAsrTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848217.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848217.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

Description.description_en: The description of the result. If the value is \`success\`, the operation is successful. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Description.description_zh: 结果描述，为success时成功，失败则返回错误信息

RetCode.description_en: The status code. A value of \`2000\` indicates that the operation is successful. Other values indicate that an error occurred
RetCode.description_zh: 状态码。返回2000表示成功，返回其他表示异常
